# {{TITLE}} ({{NAME}} {{VERSION}})

Generated by `npm run scaffold:service` on {{DATE}}. A fact not known yet is marked pending until
the phase that fills it: intake (`qa-intake`), design (`qa-design`) or automate (`qa-automate`).
`npm run lint:docs` reports a fact still pending once the pack is past its phase, and every later
phase keeps the facts current. Facts the pack already owns are linked, not copied
(`.claude/rules/documentation.md`).

## Contract

- Tracked copy: `services/{{NAME}}/{{SPEC}}` ({{FORMAT}}, {{OPERATIONS}} operations). Its digest is
  `docs/discovery/{{NAME}}-digest.json`; `npm run contract:digest:live -- --service {{NAME}}` compares
  it with the deployed contract.
- Declared servers: {{SERVERS}}.
- Departures from the contract: `services/{{NAME}}/docs/contract-notes.md`.

## Environments and writes

The environments where this pack runs, its base URL in each and whether writes are allowed there
are set in qa-config (`api.environments.<env>.packs.{{NAME}}`). Which environments exist for this
API, and which shared records must never change: _pending until intake_.
